llm_top3.reasoning: FLR (rank 4) has the strongest fundamental catalyst set: a large Q2 beat, $26.9B backlog with 85% reimbursable contracts, a wave of analyst target increases, and a multi-year technical breakout — best risk/reward in the pool. USFD (rank 23) pairs a clean beat-and-reaffirm quarter with 52-week highs and defensive food-distribution demand, a better news profile than its rank suggests. SPGI (rank 3) offers a real value-unlock catalyst in the potential Capital IQ Pro spinoff plus completed portfolio reshaping. I skip top-ranked PEGA (down 43% YTD, insider selling, contested AI narrative) and HLX (merger closing means the equity ceases trading, capping forward upside despite its high quant rank).
